 Cyclone Arnab Update: The eye of Cyclone Arnab is reported to be clearly visible on the Visakhapatnam radar as rain affects parts of Odisha. Rainfall has been reported in some areas of Puri, Ganjam, Gajapati, Rayagada and Khordha districts.
 Amid the cyclone situation, a two-day school holiday has been announced in Puri and Nayagarh districts, according to the information provided in this report. Residents and parents should follow official district administration notices for confirmed holiday dates and further instructions.
